operator.faq.q003: Real-time monitoring dashboard: the [Charger Monitoring] module displays, in graphical and list form, the real-time physical status of chargers and connectors at every site across the entire network (Idle, Preparing, Charging, Faulted, Offline), and shows in real time each charger's charging kWh for the day, number of vehicles served, output voltage and current, real-time power, and cumulative revenue;

24-hour utilization fluctuation line chart analysis: intuitively presents a site's peak transaction periods within a day (e.g., the 12:00～14:00 midday shift-change charging peak for taxis and ride-hailing vehicles) and its trough periods (e.g., the 02:00～06:00 late-night idle period);
Dynamic pricing and operations optimization:
For trough periods whose utilization stays below 10% year-round: lower the service fee and, in cooperation with fleets, introduce nighttime monthly parking-and-charging packages to increase revenue from idle assets;
For queuing-congestion periods whose utilization exceeds 80%: appropriately raise the service fee or shorten the overtime occupancy fee grace period, accelerating vehicle turnover and guiding some price-sensitive users to divert to nearby friendly sites for charging.
💡Business enablement and recommendations: through a precise “shave peaks and fill valleys” price lever, a site's comprehensive daily revenue can typically be increased by 15%～25%, while simultaneously reducing the impact on grid load.
